en-US.description: Fast, keyboard-driven two-panel file manager for Windows with archive browsing, file viewers and plugins.
en-US.installationNotes:
The Markdown viewer renders through the Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime,
which is part of Windows 11. On Windows 10 install it once with:
winget install Microsoft.EdgeWebView2Runtime
en-US.longDescription:
Tandem Commander is an open-source two-panel (dual-pane) file manager for
Windows. It is a native application - there is no runtime to install and it
starts instantly.

Both panels show a directory, and every operation - copy, move, delete,
rename, pack, unpack, compare - works between them and can be driven entirely
from the keyboard. Common archive formats are browsed like ordinary folders.
A plugin architecture adds file viewers, FTP and SFTP clients, checksum
tools, a Markdown viewer and more.

It offers full Unicode and long-path support, a dark theme, sync-status
badges for cloud-synced folders, and a configurable command shell.

Tandem Commander is built with AI-assisted, spec-driven development under
human direction and review, and is provided "as is", without warranty of any
kind.
en-US.name: Tandem Commander
en-US.releaseNotes:
Build 196. Feature release. Tandem Commander can update itself: it downloads
the new version from GitHub, checks it and installs it with one click - or
at once, if you choose so - and starts again. Unpack no longer deletes a
disc image or archive whose files it did not all extract, and many damaged
disc images no longer crash or freeze the program. Toolbar, menu, drive and
plug-in icons share one modern style with dark variants, the old icons one
click away; panel tabs get a rounded look, can move to the other panel and
sit at the same height in the Dark theme. WSL distributions appear in the
Change Drive menu, Shift+F6 renames in place, and the reports made on GitHub
about sorting in Find, copying code in the Markdown Viewer, cut-off mask
hints and tab dragging are fixed.
